goal: List all TypeScript files and explain what each module does
summary: inventory every .ts/.tsx module in the repo and document its purpose

tasks.name: inventory-modules
tasks.scopedGoal: Produce a complete inventory of every TypeScript source file (`*.ts` and `*.tsx`, excluding `*.d.ts` ambient declarations only when they're trivially re-exports — still include them and label as type declarations) in the leveling.zone repository, with a one-paragraph (2-4 sentence) explanation of what each module does. Read every TS/TSX file before describing it; do not guess from filenames alone. Group entries by top-level directory (`src/app/`, `src/app/api/`, `src/components/`, `src/lib/`, `src/utils/`, `src/types/`, `src/services/`, `src/scripts/`, `src/constants/`, and any root-level files like `route.ts`, `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`). Within each group, sort alphabetically. For each file include: the path, a short label (e.g. `Next.js route handler`, `React component`, `utility module`, `type declaration`, `Node CLI script`), and the 2-4 sentence explanation covering what it exports, who calls it, and any notable side effects (file I/O, network, env reads, etc.). At the top of the report add a one-paragraph repository overview synthesizing the codebase's purpose based on what you read (do not invent context not present in the files). Write the report to `docs/typescript-modules.md`, commit it to the worker branch with message `docs: inventory TypeScript modules`, and push. Open a draft PR titled `docs: inventory TypeScript modules` against `main` describing the report and listing the file count. In the handoff `## What I did` and `## Notes`, include the per-directory file counts and any notable observations (duplicate files, unused modules, suspicious patterns) so the planner can summarize for the user without re-reading the entire report. Do not modify any TS/TSX source files; this is a documentation-only task.
acceptance: `docs/typescript-modules.md` exists on the worker branch and is committed
Every `*.ts` and `*.tsx` file under the repo (including root-level `route.ts`, `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx` and `page.tsx.new`) appears as an entry in the report
Each entry has a path, a short label, and a 2-4 sentence explanation grounded in the file's actual contents
Entries are grouped by top-level directory and sorted alphabetically inside each group
Report opens with a one-paragraph repository overview synthesizing what the codebase does
Worker handoff includes per-directory file counts in `## Notes` so the planner can reuse them in the user-facing answer
Draft PR titled `docs: inventory TypeScript modules` is open against `main`
